retrievalProfile.description: A 1960s-style layout featuring a band in mod attire standing on stone steps, topped by a large, wavy, illustrated title banner.
triggerTerms: purple and blue vintage color palette

recipe.visualDefinition: A low-angle photograph of a group of men in matching military-style mod jackets standing on tiered stone steps, framed at the top by a large, blue, cloud-like wavy banner containing bold, stylized typography.
coreVisualRelationships: The large banner at the top anchors the composition and contains all primary text.
The subjects are arranged diagonally following the rise of the stone steps.
The purple-tinted stone provides a monochromatic texture that contrasts with the blue banner.
coreInvariants: Wavy, irregular border on the top graphic element
Matching mod-style uniforms (dark jackets, light trousers)

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subjects are medium-scale, staggered vertically and horizontally across the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, vibrant blue wavy banner at the top edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bold title in the banner, then follows the line of figures down the stone steps.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Limited; the composition is densely packed with texture and graphic elements.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: White and dark navy (clothing and text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the graphic banner against a desaturated, tinted photographic background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold slab serif with decorative flares
letterConstructionRules: Letters follow the curve of the wavy banner
Internal decorative white lines or shadows within glyphs
characterSpecificRedesigns: O and C characters are wide and circular
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Secondary text uses a smaller, sans-serif or slab-serif font in a contrasting color (purple) within the same banner.
graphicDevices: Wavy cloud-like banner with magenta outline

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the decorative slab-serif feel and heavy weight.
Provides the necessary vertical impact and slab serifs.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a low-angle photo of five men in 1960s mod military jackets and light pants standing on large, weathered stone steps. Apply a purple and grey vintage film tint. Leave the top 30% of the frame clear for a graphic overlay.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, wavy blue banner at the top with a thin magenta border. Inside the banner, place bold, white, arched slab-serif text for the title, a row of small stars, and smaller purple sub-text.

verificationChecks: Is the title text arched to match the banner curve?
Does the background have a distinct purple/magenta color cast?
Are the subjects wearing matching 1960s-style uniforms?
Is the banner shape irregular and 'cloud-like'?

adjustableVariables: Number of figures on the steps
Complexity of the banner's wavy edge

mustAchieve: Hand-drawn feel to the banner graphic

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is legible despite the warp.
Verify the stone texture looks like natural weathered masonry.
Check that the blue of the banner is the most vibrant element.
Confirm the low-angle perspective is maintained.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Subject: Group in Uniforms] + [Setting: Stone Architecture] + [Filter: 60s Purple Tint] + [Graphic: Wavy Arched Title Banner].
